'''''Allium roseum''''', commonly called '''rosy garlic''',<ref name=BSBI07>{{BSBI 2007 |access-date=2014-10-17 }}</ref> is an edible, [[Old World]] species of wild [[garlic]]. It is native to the [[Mediterranean Sea|Mediterranean]] region and nearby areas, with a natural range extending from [[Portugal]] and [[Morocco]] to [[Turkey]] and the [[Palestine (WGSRPD)|Palestine region]]. It is cultivated widely, and has become naturalised in scattered locations in other regions outside its natural range.<ref name=ursula/>

== Description ==
''Allium  roseum'' grows naturally to about {{convert|18|in|cm}} high in well-drained [[soil]]s, and in Europe blooms from late spring to early summer.<ref name=gc>{{cite web |url=http://www.gardeningcentral.org/allium_roseum/allium_roseum.html |title=Tips on Growing Allium Roseum |publisher=Gardening Central |access-date=July 29, 2010| archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20100812090821/http://www.gardeningcentral.org/allium_roseum/allium_roseum.html| archive-date= 12 August 2010 | url-status= live}}</ref>

The inflorescences of ''A. roseum'' are [[umbel]]s. The loose, fragrant [[floret]]s are about {{convert|3|in}} long, having six pinkish to [[lilac]] [[tepal]]s.<ref name=gc/>

The smell and flavour of the [[bulb]] is powerful enough to drive [[squirrel]]s and browsing [[deer]] away from gardens, where they are planted as ornamental flowers. For this reason, they are suitable as [[companion planting|companion plants]] to [[tulip]]s and similar species.<ref name=gc/>

==Taxonomy==
''Allium roseum'' was originally described and published by [[Carl Linnaeus]] in his ''{{lang|la|[[Species Plantarum]]}}'' in 1753.<ref name="GRIN"/>

;Subspecies + varieties<ref name=ursula/>
Numerous names have been proposed at the subspecies and varietal levels within the species, but only a few are currently accepted:
* ''Allium roseum'' subsp. ''gulekense'' <small>Koyuncu & Eker</small> - [[Turkey]]
* ''Allium roseum'' subsp. ''roseum'' - most of species range
* ''Allium roseum'' var. ''roseum'' - most of species range
* ''Allium roseum'' var. ''tourneuxii'' <small>Boiss.</small> - [[Israel]], [[Palestine]], [[Egypt]], [[Libya]], [[Tunisia]], [[Algeria]]

;formerly included<ref name=ursula/>
* ''Allium roseum'' var. ''cassium'', now called ''[[Allium cassium]]'' 
* ''Allium roseum'' subsp. ''permixtum'', now called ''[[Allium permixtum]]'' 
* ''Allium roseum'' subsp. ''persicum'', now called ''[[Allium tripedale]]''
* ''Allium roseum'' var. ''puberulum'', now called ''[[Allium cassium]]''
